Hi Samir — thanks for the template and the clear questions. Quick answers up front, then I'm looping in the internal team to confirm operational details.

- Term options: We can do either a straight 12-month private offer or a staged flow: 3-month paid pilot (private offer) with an optional conversion to a 12-month commitment. The conversion can be automated in the PO terms (a convert-to-annual clause) but procurement needs to be explicit about the automatic conversion trigger.
- Approvals on our side: for pricing/discount approvals we require Sales Ops + Sales manager signoff (that’s me). Anything above the delegated discount threshold also needs Finance/CFO signoff. For co-sell entitlements we also require a Partner Ops acknowledgement so co-sell is recorded for Marketplace reports.
- Security docs: I attached Redwood SOC2 summary and the private offer terms workbook (see attachments). If Nexus needs full evidence (detailed audit logs), we can provide additional extracts through an NDA.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samir — confirm whether Nexus will accept a 3-month pilot that auto-converts, or if you need an opt-in conversion.
2) If auto-convert: please add the conversion clause to the attached PO and return. I will route for Sales Ops pricing confirmation.
3) If annual right away: flag any special billing cadence (monthly vs. upfront) and I’ll map finance routing.

Looping in Vivek and Priyom to weigh in on discount windows and co-sell acknowledgement process.

Thanks,

Aisha / team — a few internal notes on gating: 

- Discounting: If Nexus asks for >25% discount on list we need Finance approval (CFO). For pilot-specific pricing we can use a time-limited pilot rate (up to 30% off) but must be explicitly flagged as pilot pricing in the PO.
- Billing cadence: Finance prefers annual prepaid for renewals (reduces risk), but we can accept monthly invoicing for pilots. If they convert to annual mid-term, we pro-rate and issue credit/adjustment at activation.
- Co-sell: Partner Ops must validate the partner relationship before finalizing co-sell entitlements. Priyom — can you confirm Partner Ops lead and whether Nexus counts as co-sell eligible?

Vivek
Director, Revenue Operations

Vivek — Partner Ops confirmed. Nexus Health is an eligible co-sell account (meets partner-engagement threshold). I started the Partner Ops acknowledgement form — will update when signed. For approvals: if they accept 3-month pilot converting automatically at month 4, we should include an explicit auto-convert clause and a manual CFO grace signoff window (48 hours) so Finance can elect to review before conversion executes. That keeps momentum but preserves finance control.

Also flagging: if they request custom SLA or data-retention beyond standard, Legal needs to review which lengthens approval. Neha — please confirm if Nexus asked for any custom security SLAs.

Subject: Nexus private offer — final routing & next steps

Samir — thanks for the fast turnaround. Based on your note and our internal checks here’s the proposed routing and the items we need to finalize so Procurement can submit the PO cleanly: 

1) Term & conversion option (you to confirm):
   - Option A (recommended): 3-month paid pilot (monthly invoicing). Pilot auto-converts to 12-month annual commitment on day 91 unless Nexus provides written notice 7 days prior to conversion. Conversion triggers proration to annual billing and any difference in price is reconciled.
   - Option B: 12-month commitment upfront (annual prepay or monthly invoice schedule — please indicate preference).

2) Pricing & approvals:
   - Pilot special pricing: up to 30% off list for a 3-month pilot (requires Sales Ops flag; if final discount >25% Finance/CFO approval required).
   - If Nexus needs deeper concession, we can route an exception but that will add 48–72h for finance signoff.

3) Co-sell acknowledgement: Partner Ops (Priyom) will complete the co-sell acknowledgement and email Nexus legal to confirm partner entitlements. That step must be done before activation.

4) Security & evidence: We supplied the SOC2 summary; if Nexus needs full audit extracts we need an NDA.

Action items for Nexus (please reply on this thread):
- Confirm Option A or Option B and preferred billing cadence.
- If Option A: confirm you accept the 7-day conversion notice window.
- Indicate whether Nexus will require prepaid annual billing on conversion.

I will prepare a redline-ready PO (mapping your Nexus_PO_Draft fields to the AWS private offer fields) as soon as you confirm. If everything is in-line we can target activation within 5 business days of signed PO (assuming no CFO escalation).

Best,
